case_number: 2024 INSC 86; CIVIL APPEAL NO. OF 2024 (Arising out of SLP(C)No.18612 of 2015)
summary: Pre-emption rights under Punjab Pre-emption Act 1913; land vs immovable property distinction; municipal notification exclusion post-sale; limitation period calculation; custom of pre-emption in extended municipal areas; right vested with tenant under Section 16; Constitution Bench test for continuous existence of right; property classified as urban immovable (rolling mill), not agricultural land; notification dated 08.10.1985 inapplicable; suit held within limitation (date of registration excluded); concurrent factual findings upheld; appeal dismissed.
final_judgment: Appeal dismissed; concurrent findings of lower courts upheld; pre-emption suit maintained.
